sources.title: GitHub - DepthAnything/Video-Depth-Anything: [CVPR 2025 Highlight ...
sources.snippet: This work presents Video Depth Anything based on Depth Anything V2, which can be applied to arbitrarily long videos without compromising quality, consistency, or generalization ability. Compared with other diffusion-based models, it enjoys faster inference speed, fewer parameters, and higher consistent depth accuracy.

sources.snippet: Long Video Results Comparison with DepthCrafter on open-world videos Comparison with DepthCrafter on Unprojected Point Cloud Intrinsic of camera as well as the aligned scale and shift parameters are obtained by running the first frame of the video through MoGe, which is a powerful model for recovering 3D geometry from monocular open-domain images.

sources.title: Video Depth Anything Large - AI Model Insights & Benchmarks
sources.snippet: Video Depth Anything is a state-of-the-art model for temporally consistent monocular depth estimation in videos. It extends Depth Anything V2 with temporal modules for smooth, flicker-free depth maps across video frames.
